description: Defines helper functions for CU-UP configuration, including default QoS configurations for different 5QI values, used in 5G NR network simulations or implementations.

methods.name: make_default_cu_up_custom_cfg_item
methods.description: Creates a default CU-UP QoS configuration item with specified warning, metrics period, and test mode settings.

methods.name: make_default_cu_up_qos_config_list
methods.description: Generates a map of default QoS configurations for various 5QI values used by gNB CU-UP.
